Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing compensation paid to peace officers while enrolled in basic law enforcement training.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to responsibility for compensation paid to peaceofficers while enrolled in basic law enforcement training; and addinga new section to chapter 43.101 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.101 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A general authority Washington law enforcement agency shallreimburse a peace officer's training agency for any training, salary,and benefits received by the peace officer while he or she was enrolledin basic law enforcement training, if the law enforcement agency hiresthe respective peace officer within five years of the peace officer'scompletion of basic law enforcement training. The hiring lawenforcement agency shall reimburse the training agency within ninetydays of the peace officer's first day of employment based on thefollowing reimbursement amounts: (a) The training agency shall bereimbursed for one hundred percent of the total amount of salary,benefits, and any training received by the peace officer if the peaceofficer was hired by the law enforcement agency within one year or lessof the peace officer's completion of the basic law enforcement p. 1 SHB 1802training; (b) the training agency shall be reimbursed for eightypercent of the total amount of salary, benefits, and any trainingreceived by the peace officer if the peace officer was hired by the lawenforcement agency within one year plus one day but no more than twoyears of the peace officer's completion of the basic law enforcementtraining; (c) the training agency shall be reimbursed for sixty percentof the total amount of salary, benefits, and any training received bythe peace officer if the peace officer was hired by the law enforcementagency within two years plus one day but no more than three years ofthe peace officer's completion of the basic law enforcement training;(d) the training agency shall be reimbursed for forty percent of thetotal amount of salary, benefits, and any training received by thepeace officer if the peace officer was hired by the law enforcementagency within three years plus one day but no more than four years ofthe peace officer's completion of the basic law enforcement training;(e) the training agency shall be reimbursed for twenty percent of thetotal amount of salary, benefits, and any training received by thepeace officer if the peace officer was hired by the law enforcementagency within four years plus one day but no more than five years ofthe peace officer's completion of the basic law enforcement training;and (f) no reimbursement shall be required to be provided to thetraining agency if the peace officer was hired by the law enforcementagency more than five years after the peace officer's completion of thebasic law enforcement training. (2) For the purposes of this section, "training agency" means a lawenforcement agency that: (a) Pays salary and any benefits to a peaceofficer while he or she is enrolled in basic law enforcement training;(b) pays any percentage of training for a peace officer along with anynecessary facilities, supplies, materials, and room and board ofnoncommuting attendees pursuant to RCW 43.101.200; (c) has ten or lessfulltime commissioned peace officers; or (d) pays a salary of onehundred fifty dollars or less per month than the hiring law enforcementagency that has employed the respective peace officer. A "trainingagency" does not include the Washington state criminal justice trainingcommission.
